verdict.rationale: The evidence says Fly.io uses pay-as-you-go pricing for compute, storage, and bandwidth, and bills disk by bytes written. It does not document any actual rates, overage fee schedule, or per-unit charges a devops lead could check before being billed. A community comment refers to 'network pricing' but gives no figures, so the exact fee schedule is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the exact overage fee schedule for exceeding plan usage limits (bandwidth, invocations, build minutes) before I get billed
